responsibility: This machine-description fragment implements the AArch64 SVE2 instruction patterns that extend the base SVE RTL description. It adds non-temporal gathers and scatters, integer widening and narrowing arithmetic, pairwise and complex operations, dot products, histogram and string-match support, extra permutes, crypto-extension instructions, and other SVE2-specific scalable-vector patterns that builtin expansion and generic RTL generation match against when TARGET_SVE2 and related extension flags are enabled.
